title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI-powered investigation of policy sync and device health
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned AI investigation capability from today's documented troubleshooting tools. The roadmap details, existing navigation paths, hunting query and dashboard permissions are supported; searches found no published feature-specific switch, default or licensing.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP monitors and can restrict the use and sharing of sensitive items on onboarded devices.

claims.claim: The existing device list exposes Configuration status for onboarded devices.
claims.quote: Configuration status and the Policy sync status of all your onboarded devices have three possible values.

claims.quote: The Policy sync status shows you if the device received the latest policy version, or if the corresponding policies synced successfully to the device.

claims.claim: The device health dashboard summarises Endpoint DLP onboarding, policy update readiness and feature readiness.
claims.quote: Use the dashboard to monitor device onboarding status, policy update readiness, and feature readiness for Endpoint DLP.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: A device must be online to receive a policy update before that update can protect it.
claims.quote: Devices must be online for the policy update to happen.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Not updated means that the device has not synced the latest policy updates.
claims.quote: This device isn't synced the latest policy updates. It might take up to 2 hours for the status in the devices list to update.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: A device missing policy updates while offline continues enforcing its existing outdated policy.
claims.quote: Policies that are updated while a device is offline won't be pushed to that device. Similarly, such policies won't be enforced on that device, until the device is back online. However, the outdated policy that exists on the offline device will still be enforced.

claims.claim: The device list's policy sync status can take up to two hours to update.
claims.quote: It might take up to 2 hours for the status in the devices list to update.

claims.quote: Last policy sync time | The timestamp of the previous instance when the device downloaded the latest policy versions.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Per-device configuration and policy sync status is reached in the Microsoft Purview portal under Settings > Device onboarding > Devices.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Settings (gear icon in the upper right corner) > Device onboarding > Devices.

claims.claim: Microsoft Defender portal Advanced hunting supports the query DeviceInfo | where DlpInfo != "" | project DlpInfo for Endpoint DLP device attributes.
claims.quote:
Go to the Microsoft Defender portal
Navigate to Investigation & response > Hunting > Advanced hunting
Query the DeviceInfo table
Expand the DlpInfo column to view Endpoint DLP device details
Sample query:
DeviceInfo
| where DlpInfo != ""
| project DlpInfo

claims.claim: The listed existing status views and hunting query read device status and attributes rather than changing the AI feature.
claims.quote: The DlpInfo column contains Endpoint Data Loss Prevention device information in JSON format. The JSON object can be used to query and report on device configuration status, policy synchronization status, Endpoint DLP enablement, and other configuration details for onboarded devices.

claims.claim: The device health reporting dashboard is in Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Device onboarding > Device report.
claims.quote:
Go to the Microsoft Purview portal.
Select Settings > Device onboarding > Device report.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Access to the device health reporting dashboard requires Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote:
To access the device health reporting dashboard, you must have one of the following roles:
- Compliance Administrator
- Security Administrator
- Global Administrator

claims.claim: Learn recommends least privilege and identifies Compliance Administrator or Security Administrator as sufficient for most organizations using the dashboard.
claims.quote: Use the least-privileged role that meets your needs. For most organizations, the Compliance Administrator or Security Administrator role is sufficient.

claims.claim: Dashboard policy update readiness indicators highlight risk rather than proving a device failed to receive an update.
claims.quote: These indicators don't confirm whether a device failed to receive a policy update, but instead highlight devices that may be at risk of not receiving future updates.

claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the device health dashboard's readiness reports is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview device health reports dashboard API PowerShell Graph. Read learn.microsoft.com/purview/device-onboarding-health-reports-dashboard and /purview/dlp-edlp-tshoot-sync. DeviceInfo exposes attributes, not the dashboard's readiness reports.

claims.where: controls[3].ui and note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The cited Learn page places the overall Policy status report on Data loss prevention > Overview, referring to the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
claims.quote: You can see the overall status of how policy sync to devices is working on the Policy status report. The Policy status report is available in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal on the > Data loss prevention > Overview page.

claims.claim: A direct API or automation equivalent for the overall Policy status report is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Policy status report API policy sync devices. Read learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-edlp-tshoot-sync and search excerpts. DeviceInfo queries device-level attributes; no direct Policy status report API found.

claims.claim: DeviceInfo.DlpInfo supports reporting device configuration validity across the estate.

claims.claim: DeviceInfo.DlpInfo includes the policy modification timestamp associated with a device.
